name_input: M/S PSYCHOTROPICS INDIA LTD. PLOT NO.46-49 SEC-6A IIE SIDCUL HARDIDWAR; Psychotropics India Limited
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for PSYCHOTROPICS INDIA LIMITED reports "Total Shipments 2378 Records detected", "Trading Partners 34", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-25". Exact row quoted: "2026-02-25 | PSYCHOTROPICS INDIA LIMITED | MEDICO S.A | PHARMACEUTICAL PRODUCT M-ATORVASTATINE 20 MG TAB ... | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Tamatave Toamasina, MADAGASCAR | 30049079 | 1013757". Further dated rows seen: 2026-02-19 B/L 9827598 to BIOGENERICS NIGERIA LIMITED, Lagos (HS 30049089); 2026-02-17 B/L 9756528 to BERHAN BANK S.C, Djibouti (HS 30049039); 2026-02-14 B/L 9677309 to THC. SOLE CO. LTD., Vientiane, Laos (HS 30049039); 2026-02-13 B/L 9650736 to COMMERCIAL BANK OF ETHIOPIA, Djibouti (HS 30042039). Source counter: page claims 2378 total shipments; 5 individual dated rows actually rendered in the free view. Top destination lanes shown: Aden 83, Djibouti 76, NHAVA SHEVA SEA 145. Declared HS 300490 is consistent with the observed 300490xx/30042039 lines (no HS correction needed).
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and B/L number — not a website claim. Domestic supply side could NOT be verified: the company website psychotropicsindia.com is a parked Hostinger domain (no content), DuckDuckGo/searx search backend was unreachable for all queries, and volza/eximpedia/trademo returned HTTP 403. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report split was retrieved, so domestic_status is 'unknown' and domestic_evidence is null — not asserted as absent. Note the customs record lists the registered address as "A-32, SECTOR-11 FARIDABAD" while the batch input cites Plot No.46-49 Sec-6A IIE SIDCUL Haridwar; both may be genuine (corporate office vs. plant) but this was not resolved. Revenue/export value figures are not public in the free views and are left null. No rejection grounds: the entity is active in customs data through 2026-02-25.
